payload.recallText: So I am at the end of the year and teaching nine year olds about the Oregon Trail. Uh, I am the puppet master. I teach playing a silly game. They know it will be a game. I want to make it real, so I take them for a walk in manhatten. it is a forty block road, not too far, about two miles. A smart alec kid named alex says he would not have to walk, he would ride in the wagon. I said the wagon was only if  we transported a piano. We all got to choose real names, so they could keep their first names. Alex was Alex Bacon. He said there is a water fountain. I thought fast and said there is a stream, I would not let a nine year old thirst for water
